title: Close the Google terms gate on prepare, start and usage reads
text: The Google terms gate in apps/controller/src/commands/google-terms.ts misses three paths. Change googleTermsGate to take a third argument, a function from a run id to whether that run is a prepared Google run. Until the current terms text is acknowledged it must also refuse a PrepareNativeRun command whose profile id starts with google-, and a StartRun command for which that function answers true. Every other command, and a StartRun for a run that is not a prepared Google run, passes (the gate returns undefined). The refusal keeps outcome blocked and reason google-terms-not-acknowledged. Export a helper googleTermsAcknowledged(store) from the same module and use it. In the controller, pass the function that asks whether a run is a prepared ACP run. Also refuse an ObserveUsage command for the google family with that same reason, and make controller.refreshGoogleUsage('start') return undefined without starting a read, until the terms are acknowledged.

verification.method: The checks ran in a clean export of the base commit with the hidden files from the solution commit in place, and had to fail. They then ran in a clean export of the solution commit, and had to pass. Installed dependencies were linked from the checkout, and the checks ran with a minimal environment and a temporary home.
